mapper.insert: INSERT INTO makeup_exam_session (course_id, semester_id, exam_date, exam_start_time, exam_end_time, location, max_capacity, enrolled_count, status) VALUES (#{courseId}, #{semesterId}, #{examDate}, #{examStartTime}, #{examEndTime}, #{location}, #{maxCapacity}, 0, '待安排')
mapper.select: SELECT sess.id, sess.course_id, c.course_name, c.course_code, sess.semester_id, sem.name AS semesterName, sess.exam_date, sess.exam_start_time, sess.exam_end_time, sess.location, sess.max_capacity, sess.enrolled_count, sess.status, sess.create_time, sess.update_time FROM makeup_exam_session sess JOIN course c ON sess.course_id = c.id JOIN semester sem ON sess.semester_id = sem.id WHERE sess.id = #{id}
